title: Dead or Alive Xtreme 3: Scarlet
synopsis: Koei Tecmo’s island-resort spin-off of Dead or Alive — retained as the Asian Nintendo Switch edition with English text, never released in the West.

catalog.region: Region-free · Asian edition with English subtitles · SXA-HAC-ASABB

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Dead or Alive Xtreme 3: Scarlet is the enhanced edition of Koei Tecmo’s resort spin-off: beach volleyball and other minigames, gift-giving, a casino, and photo modes on Venus Island. The cartridge holds all eleven playable characters, including newcomers Misaki and Leifang.

It released on PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch in Japan and Asia on March 20, 2019. Koei Tecmo did not release it in North America or Europe in any form; the Asian edition carries English subtitles.

This filing opens the Dead or Alive lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is the Asian retail edition of Dead or Alive Xtreme 3: Scarlet on a Nintendo Switch game card, with Japanese voices and English subtitles.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Dead or Alive Xtreme 3 released on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita in Japan in 2016. Scarlet released in Japan and Asia on March 20, 2019. No Western release followed.
preservation.availability: Physically distributed in Japan and Asia only; never released in North America or Europe.
